facilities.notes: NRCS SCAN station; the official NWCC site page and site notes name no PI, manager or operator (they only point to a generic NRCS state contact page, which did not respond). Reporting since 1999-03-19. The data.gov record (published by Agricultural Research Service, keyword WGEW) lists Dino DeSimone as dataset contactPoint; he does not appear on the current NRCS Arizona state office directory, so his current status is unconfirmed. The station sits in the USDA-ARS Walnut Gulch Experimental Watershed; the LTAR WGEW page lists SCAN among networks with which WGEW shares data, so the WGEW/SWRC Research Leader (Philip Heilman) is recorded as host-site leadership at low confidence, not as station PI. NRCS AZ directory lists a Water Supply Specialist for snow survey questions but nothing ties that person to this SCAN station, so not added. Status 0 = connection timeout from nrcs.usda.gov / wcc.nrcs.usda.gov. VERIFIER 2026-10-22: Re-fetched NWCC site page, site notes, data.gov record, LTAR WGEW page and Heilman ARS profile (all 200). Dropped Philip Heilman: the LTAR page is about the Walnut Gulch Experimental Watershed (an ARS facility), not this NRCS SCAN station; SCAN appears there only as a network WGEW shares data with, so the page does not show him in any role at this station. He belongs on a WGEW facility record, not here. Kept Dino DeSimone at low confidence: the data.gov record for this station (modified 2025-11-22) lists him as contactPoint; 'data-manager' is the nearest allowed role for a dataset contact, and he is absent from the current NRCS AZ directory mirror, so current status rests only on that record. Email address deliberately not recorded.
